name: Baptist history
about: The line of believers and the Baptist distinctives through history: history to learn from, not another system to be married to.

teachings.title: Job: faith in God before Abraham
teachings.theme: A line of faith since Abel
teachings.summary: Job shows that men feared and called on the Lord before and outside Abraham's seed, so salvation by grace through faith was always offered to all people.
teachings.text:
The Book of Job begins with the introduction of a man in the land of Uz, the titular character; Job. Uz, from the biblical clues appears to be a fertile plane in the Arabian peninsula, near where Edom would be. The time frame, many believe, is during the era of the patriarchs; Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

It would be good to note that, Abraham, or Abram, was a Chaldean, a nation who are mentioned here in this chapter located in what is modern Iraq. Where the seat of Babylonian power would be. And he was called out from the city of Ur there, to go unto Hebron by God.

And, as mentioned throughout his story and his sons', there were people in this post flood era who feared the Lord, and offered sacrifices unto him.

Of course we know about Melchizedek, King of Salem, and high priest, and the tenth of the spoils offered by Abram to Melchizedek. Many consider him to be a pre-incarnate appearance of Jesus.

All this to say that the idea of the worship of God originating with Abraham, and only his seed after the flesh, is incorrect. There were many following the flood and the dispersion of nations out from Babel, that called upon the name of the Lord for salvation, and sought to offer the blood as a picture of their faith in Him, as we see Job does for himself and his family.

One of the conceits of modern Zionism and dispensationalism holds that only the sons of Israel after the flesh were special, and that they invented monotheism. But throughout the Bible we find people who were not of that line, and not given to idols and false gods. It's important to understand that salvation has always been by grace alone through faith in the Lord, calling upon his name. And that salvation was always offered to all people.

We will see in Exodus the mixed multitudes that followed Israel into the wilderness from Egypt. We will see high priests of other nations that fear the Lord. There will be people like Ruth and Rahab and others who have the faith.

The distinction for Israel was that they were given the oracles of God. That they had the prophets and the word of God delivered directly to them, and given the law of the Lord that they may be perfect, complete, and a light unto the Gentiles. The other nations. Calling all men to repentance.

But we see the greatest man on Earth at this moment, according to God, who feared Him, eschewing evil, offering sacrifices to sanctify himself and his family. Without the law. Without the temple. Without a priesthood. Without the oracles of God, knowing by the faith of his fathers what was expected.

teachings.title: A trail of blood of believers
teachings.theme: A line of faith since Abel
teachings.summary: Saved believers stand in an unbroken line of faith, bearing fruit after its kind from Abel through the apostles to today, linked by a trail of martyrs' blood persecuted by Rome and the false church.
teachings.text:
**Genesis 1:11**
*And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.*

**Matthew 21:43**
*Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.*

Matthew 7:16-18
*Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles? Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit. A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.*

**Philippians 1**:**4-11**
*Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy, For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now; Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace. For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ. And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment; That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ. Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.*

**Romans 1:16-17**
*For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek. For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.*

I am a saved Christian. Born again by the faith that was shared to me by another saved Christian, who in turn believed and was converted by yet another saved. Christian. A line of succession going back to the beginning of the world. That the just live by faith and bear fruit after its own kind.

A line of believers stretching back to Adam. To Abel. To Seth and Enos.

The same faith of Abraham who believed the Lord and it was counted upon him for righteousness. The same faith that makes up the record of the "Hall of faith," in Hebrews chapter 11.

The same faith preached by John, the Baptist in the wilderness, taught by Christ Himself during His earthly ministry, given to the apostles as the keys to overcome death and hell. Preached on the day of Pentecost. Given to the Jews and to the Greek. The salvation that is by calling upon the name of the Lord. By believing on the finished work of Christ Jesus as the propitiation of our sin.

And, like the blood of the prophets from Abel to Zechariah, and of Jesus and the Apostles, and of the believers persecuted by the Jews and the Romans, a trail of blood that links believing Christians today to those that were martyred for the same faith in the same Gospel of grace and reconciliation. A trail of blood that continued through the persecution by Constantine's cult, through the dark ages, during the Reformation, under Bloody Mary, and that will mark the great tribulation to come.

teachings.title: The five fundamentals of the faith
teachings.summary: The 1910 Presbyterian Doctrinal Deliverance set out the five fundamentals, inerrancy, virgin birth, atonement, bodily resurrection and miracles, the origin of the name fundamentalist.
teachings.text:
"Under the order of the Presbyterian Church in the USA, the General Assembly was not authorized to accept or dismiss the complaint. It should have demitted the complaint to the presbytery and could have done so with instructions that the presbytery hold a heresy trial. The result of the trial could then be appealed to the Synod of New York and from there to the General Assembly. However, the 1910 General Assembly, acting outside its scope of authority, dismissed the complaint against the three men and at the same time instructed its Committee on Bills and Overtures to prepare a statement for governing future ordinations. The committee reported, and the General Assembly passed the Doctrinal Deliverance of 1910, which declared that five doctrines were "necessary and essential" to the Christian faith:

-The inspiration of the Bible by the Holy Spirit and the inerrancy of Scripture as a result of this.
-The virgin birth of Christ.
-The belief that Christ's death was an atonement for sin.
-The bodily resurrection of Christ.
-The historical reality of Christ's miracles.

The five propositions would become known to history as the "Five Fundamentals" and by the late 1910s, theological conservatives rallying around the Five Fundamentals came to be known as "fundamentalists."'

If that's called "fundamentalism" then by God I am happy to be a fundamentalist!

teachings.title: Standing for the reading of the Word
teachings.summary: As all the people stood when Ezra opened the book, Baptists stand out of respect for God's word, and the called out assembly exists to read the scriptures distinctly and give the sense.
teachings.text:
*And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.*

Pay attention in church, when the pastor or anyone is at the pulpit, reading and expounding on the scriptures. Sit up straight. Ears open. Receiving it gladly.

*Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose...And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up*

Here is the tradition we Baptists have, of standing out of respect for God's word as the man of God preaches from the pulpit.

*...and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place. So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.*

This is the purpose of the called out assembly. To give understanding to the people, reading from the Law of God distinctly.

*And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the Lord with their faces to the ground.*

This is the way to worship God in spirit and truth.

Notice the people were outside. They made booths of branches. It was simple and about God and His word.

The Roman Catholics would say you must have a temple to worship God. The Jews in Jerusalem had the best temple, and yet they pitched tents to hear sermons preached from an old wooden pulpit.

**Acts 7:48-49**
*Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet, Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?*

Never mind those that need worldly things, carnal, idols of wood, metal and stone. Beads. Incense. Stained glass and marble. They have to have carnal and worldly things because they do not worship God in spirit and truth. They need physical relics and iconography because they lack the Spirit.

Baptists follow the Bible.

teachings.title: Ecumenism refused and persecution follows
teachings.summary: Zerubbabel rightly refused the Samaritans' ecumenical offer, and like them false religions, Rome included, use governments to stop true churches and soul winners.
teachings.text:
So these Samaritans were offering an ecumenical union to build the Lord's house, similar to if a group of Catholics sought to join with a NT Baptist Church. And naturally, Zerubbabel rejected their offer as tainted. Offended, these false religions begin to petition the government of Persia to stop the rebuilding effort.

**Ezra 4** documents the pre-520 BC efforts by Judah's enemies to undermine the temple rebuilding that began shortly after Cyrus's decree in 538 BC, and persisting throughout his reign, through his predecessor Cambyses's rule (530-522 BC), and into Darius I's early years, circa 522 BC, resulting in halted work until Darius's second year in 520, when Haggai and Zechariah pick up.

The chapter also mentions later similar oppositions during Ahasuerus's reign (likely Xerxes I, starting around 486 BC) with initial accusations, and under Artaxerxes I (465-424 BC) via detailed letters that enforced a cessation of Jerusalem's reconstruction as a threat. Ezra lists all these efforts as one long opposition campaign.

How relatable this is to our modern day efforts of soul-winning and building up the house of God. How frequently do false "Christian" leaders join together to get Bible-believing church's "in trouble" with the local government? To try to stop door to door evangelism, labeling it as solicitation. To try and get churches denounced and shut down for preaching against the sodomites.

When you look at the history of the Roman Catholic Church, it literally was formed by apostates working in conjunction with the government to shut down and martyr believers and good NT churches, to force them out. Declaring their pastors heretics. History is filled with these same types of people.

But God had promised in the 70th year of captivity to turn towards the people if they built His house. And Darius I blessed the construction, and it resumed for a while.

teachings.title: No freedom of religion in the Kingdom
teachings.summary: Conversion comes by the word and never the sword, so the Baptist distinctive of freedom from state religion is right, churches should be local, independent and Christ led, and a godly people should not allow false religions to be practiced.
teachings.text:
There is no "freedom of religion" in the Kingdom of Heaven. There is a right to individuals to choose not to believe. No one can force conversion by the sword, only by the word. But the allowance and practice of false religions should never be allowed by a Christian people.

The Baptist Distinctive regarding freedom from state religion is good, and right. A secular denomination with political power to force conversions will always create false gospels and result in persecution of believers. Churches should be local and independent, Christ led. Not top-down controlled by men.

A nation of believers should enforce this rule, destroying cults that worship other gods and lead others to apostasy. In my opinion.

But to have such a thing requires a godly people. The blessings of liberty are only bestowed on a nation when a large enough portion are at liberty in Christ.

Idolatrous sects, pagans, Jews, satanic cults, perverse groups who seek after other gods, rejecting the God of our fathers, should never have been given the freedom to spread their abominations.

There was a time when our forefathers understood that. The same people who wrote and adopted the Bill of Rights did not allow antichrist religions. Or at least tried not to. They blew it, in the end. And our people turned from God and now we suffer as a nation for it, making the point moot.

But this will be enforced in the Millennium. Amen.

teachings.title: The gospel of grace in every age
teachings.summary: God's grace through faith was given in every age from Adam and preached by the prophets, and the Judaizers' works gospel persecuted it.
teachings.text:
So, to review, Paul has established the truth of God, the need for both Jew and Gentile to be saved. That all are dead in sin.

Now, recall the larger context of these epistles, established in **Acts 15**;

*But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses*.

These Judaizers were the main impetus for the epistles to the various churches by the apostles, to keep the newly regenerate Jews and Gentiles, babes in Christ, from being taken in by the false teachings of a works based salvation.

Now the grace of God was established with Adam, and every just man from Seth on called upon the name of the Lord to be saved. His grace was given in faith to all ages, and every prophet spoke of His longsuffering and salvation given to those who hear His word and believe.

In **Hebrews 11**, Paul gives a recitation of the more famous OT saints, saved by faith alone, after establishing what faith is.

*Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen. For by it the elders obtained a good report. Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.*

The Gospel of grace caused the Jews to persecute Christians from city to city, even as they sought to creep into houses and corrupt them.

The Gospel of grace was preached by the prophets, seeking to turn Israel to repentance, and they were murdered for it.

As Jesus preached against the Jews in **Matthew 23**;

*Upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.*

teachings.title: Mystery Babylon, the mother of harlots
teachings.summary: The great whore on seven hills is Rome and its apostate church, with the false religions sprung from her as harlot daughters, drunk with the blood of the saints she martyred in a trail of blood, until the beast and his kingdom make war with the Lamb and are overcome.
teachings.text:
The Whore, Mystery Babylon the Great. Mother of harlots and abominations. Drunken with the blood of the saints she martyred. The golden cup filled of her filthy fornication and abominations.

*That great city which reigneth over the kings of the earth*.

Sitting upon 7 mountains.
Given power by kings to rule.
Decked in purple and scarlet, gold and precious stones and pearls.

Sitting upon many waters, which are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.

Who is this great whore? This mother of harlots? This city on 7 mountains, that sits on many waters? Who has martyred the saints of Jesus and committed fornication and blasphemy and other abominations against God?

The city on seven hills is Rome. Its whore, the false religion and apostate church of the Roman Catholics. The harlot daughters all the other false religions that have sprung from it. The Orthodox and the Protestant. All those calling themselves Christ's, professing themselves to be holy and true. But drunk in her fornications. Idolatry. Blasphemy. The abominations of her golden cup. The power of her political control, given by the kings that committed adultery with her. The murder of millions of believers, in a trail of blood, as this empire of mirey clay and iron has conquered much of the earth.

In the end, the 7th empire as described by Daniel (we will look at Daniel 7 tomorrow, along with the destruction of Babylon), will give the beast power to reign and will promote the worship of the beast who was, is not and is again. The fatal wound and Satan bringing the antichrist back to life as the man of perdition, and installing him as the head of the final one world government and religion for a short space.

*These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.*
